title: Who speaks for Europe abroad? Not its top diplomat
summary_full: EU leaders’ decision to exclude the bloc’s foreign policy chief from their negotiating lineup for Russia peace talks reveals how national turf wars undermine Brussels’ global ambitions• Don’t get This Is Europe delivered to your inbox? Sign up hereThe EU, we are repeatedly told, wants (and needs) to be a global player, a geopolitical heavyweight capable of shaping its own foreign and security policies – or at the very least, speaking with one clear, unambiguous voice on the world stage.Last Friday’s summit in Dublin, when leaders debated who should represent the bloc in talks aimed at ending Russia’s war on Ukraine – the gravest security crisis the EU has faced in decades – showed once again that it is unlikely to find such a voice anytime soon.
